refactorSummary: Preserved canonical source and destination URI semantics through snapshots, assignment polling, execution, status reads, and logging for both governed directions.

refactorSummary: Applied canonical configured-root confinement to every agent-local path and rejected credential-bearing URI user-info for both transfer directions.
Bound the queued remote endpoint, policy digest/version, agent pool, and network zone to controller authorization and rechecked all attributes at the agent boundary.
Connected HTTP, SFTP, and FTPS sockets to policy-authorized resolved addresses while preserving the authorized hostname for HTTP Host headers, TLS SNI, and hostname verification.
Made active route probing explicit, bounded, and opt-in, with stage-by-stage redacted results suitable for operations diagnostics.
Loaded only the selected approved CA certificate into an augmented PKIX trust store and retained hostname and optional leaf-pin verification.
Separated authorization events from actual connection-use events and made time-based secret expiry a replicated state transition with an auditable event.
Updated real FTP, FTPS, and SFTP integration fixtures to exercise credential-free endpoint URIs and transfer-scoped runtime credentials.
